name: dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine-fonts
description: Font system for the DSH wallpaper engine: the appearance tab's font section and the font-set editor (browser half, packages/fonts/lib/client.fonts.js) plus the host routes /fontsets and /system-fonts. Config keys and state stay in the main bundle (ADR-0013 D20); the only cross-package channel is the main bundle's explicit host bridge（浏览器半边契约见 ADR-0014 S3.8/S3.9 与 .integration-notes/p-c-contract.md）.
